sufficiency_warnings: Source is correspondence rather than a primary comparative clinical study; most numerical claims are reported examples or cited secondary data.

extraction_limitations: The two-page PDF contains multiple unrelated letters in adjacent journal columns. Extraction was deliberately restricted to “Clinical Use of the Heparin Nomogram,” its references, and the directly associated reply; thyroid and trichloroethane correspondence were excluded.

This source is editorial correspondence, not a prospective trial or full methods paper. Quantitative values are reported examples, proficiency-testing observations, or local correlations with limited methodological detail in the letter itself.
The local APTT-to-heparin correlations do not report sample size, regression methods, uncertainty, or patient-level outcomes in this correspondence.
The 1.5-2.0 times-control APTT statement is a historical recommendation cited by the 1991 authors and should not be interpreted as a contemporary standalone therapeutic target.
No bleeding or thrombosis outcomes are reported in the correspondence.
All atoms are marked needs_review because they were generated by a language model and have not been independently human-verified against the source.
